title: ContinuousAlignmentMemoryRecord
description: Schema for distilled agent memories and workspace invariants

memory_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the memory item

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the insight was distilled

scope.description: Whether this rule applies globally or to a specific path glob

target_path_glob.description: Glob pattern specifying when path-scoped rules apply (e.g. 'skills/docs/**')

statement.description: Actionable, imperative rule or invariant statement

rationale.description: Why this rule exists, grounded in transcript evidence or error resolution

source_conversation_id.description: Antigravity conversation ID where the insight originated

confidence.description: Confidence score of the distillation (must be >= 0.8 for auto-merging)

supersedes.description: Memory ID of a superseded or contradicted rule
